notes.raw: * ''Dominus' ''[[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is not refunded if '''Renekton''' [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]] during the cast animation. * ''Dominus' ''bonus health gain does not interact with [[File:Spirit Visage item.png|20xpx|border|link=Spirit Visage|An icon for the item Spirit Visage]] [[Spirit Visage]] or [[File:Grievous Wounds icon.png|20px|link=Grievous Wounds|An icon representing the keyword Grievous wounds]] [[:Grievous Wounds|Grievous Wounds]]. ** '''Renekton''' retains ''Dominus' ''bonus health (if not over his normal maximum) once the duration ends.
notes.text:
Dominus'  cooldown is not refunded if Renekton dies during the cast animation.
Dominus' bonus health gain does not interact with Spirit Visage or Grievous Wounds.
* Renekton retains Dominus' bonus health (if not over his normal maximum) once the duration ends.
